action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated (strength 0.98) with moderate seasonality and non-stationary behavior. Model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.068, no model consistently top-3) and errors are highly correlated (mean 0.754, only 4 independent groups out of 19). The meta-model weighted combination (w1) already adapts to this by down-weighting redundant models and leveraging cross-window information, which is exactly what a robust strategy needs under unstable ranking. The runner-up (plain mean, 0.6667) is not statistically distinguishable from the leader (0.6557), confirming that no simpler or more complex combination offers a real gain over the fitted weighting for this series.
